note: Frozen before any learned-model comparison. Changing a value requires a new dated version and a reason recorded in docs/evaluation-protocol.md.

belgium.first_validation_rule: first target day whose weather run (00 UTC or 06 UTC of D-1) is initialised on or after 2024-11-12 00Z, when 49r1 became operational
belgium.daylight_points: unweighted mean of the 11 province points

pvdaq.first_validation_rule: first target day whose weather run (00 UTC of the issuance day D-1) is initialised on or after 2024-11-12 00Z

training.rule: a model for a fold is fitted once, before the fold's first issuance, on target days <= fold start - label_lag_days; expanding window; no refit inside a fold

scoring.scored_hour: target eligible (observed, no exclusion) and weather_complete and capacity_complete and persistence available
scoring.daylight: sun's upper limb above the horizon (apparent elevation > -0.833 deg) at the start or end of the hour
scoring.complete_day: every hour of the local day scored and the target day_complete
scoring.postprocessing: every candidate's prediction is clipped to [0, capacity x 1 h]; the Elia benchmark is scored as published
scoring.primary_metric: daylight hourly MAE on the primary kind, pooled over validation folds

slices.season: DJF, MAM, JJA, SON by target month
slices.sky: daylight mean of the forecast cloud_cover per target day: clear < 30 %, mixed 30 to 70 %, overcast > 70 %

resampling.method: paired moving-block bootstrap over target days, circular
resampling.statistic: difference in daylight MAE, candidate minus reference, on identical scored hours

selection.rule: a learned candidate replaces the best baseline only if its pooled validation daylight MAE is at least 5 % lower, the upper bound of the 95 % paired-bootstrap interval of the difference is below zero, and it is better in at least all but one validation fold
selection.simpler_rule: among candidates within 2 % of the best pooled daylight MAE, choose the one with fewer inputs, then lower inference cost

resources.where: inference on the always-on deployment host (measured in #6), training on a development machine

belgium.basis: assumed fleet geometry and ratio, not fitted; the Belgian fleet orientation and losses are unknown

pvdaq.ac_limit_basis: 24 x 30 kW maximum output power of the ABB TRIO-27.6-TL-OUTD (US datasheet 9AKK106103A4856); the meter peak 707.84 kW is below it. Effective export limit unknown
pvdaq.basis: documented installation geometry and capacity; temperature coefficient, losses and inverter efficiency are assumptions, not fitted
